title: Compute ideal-gas coefficients from γ=3
action: Compute coefficients A, B, α1, α2, α3 using the polytropic ideal-gas formulas with γ=3.
description: Computes the model coefficients A, B, α1, α2, α3 from the ideal gas exponent γ=3 using the relationships given in the paper (Eqs. 35 and 37). The values are saved to a text evidence file.

title: Run inert acoustic resonance simulations
action: Solve the inert system (38) with A=0.2, B=0.25, initial data (40) for each φ in {0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875}. Record the maximum sound amplitude (max Σ) for each case.
description: Solves the inert acoustic resonance equations for the full set of relative phases φ. The maximum sound component amplitude (max Σ) is extracted and logged.

title: Run chemical-acoustic linear resonance simulations
action: Solve the reduced system (46) with α1=α2=α3=1/3 (γ=3), initial data (50) for the same φ set. Record blowup time t* for each φ.
description: Simulates the chemical-acoustic linear resonance (temperature‑dependent chemistry only, no inert terms). Blowup times t* are recorded.

title: Run full temperature-dependent system simulations
action: Solve the full system (41) with A=1, B=0.25, α1=α3=1/3, α2=1/3 (γ=3), initial data (51) for the same φ set. Record blowup time t* and the blowing‑up mode (Entropy, Left sound, or Right sound).
description: Simulates the complete temperature‑dependent system including both inert resonance and combustion terms. Blowup times and the mode that blows up are recorded.

title: Run pressure-sensitive system simulations with large entropy kernel
action: Solve the pressure‑sensitive system (52) with A=1, B=0.25, α=2 (γ=3), initial data (56) for φ=0.125 and φ=0.5. Record blowup time t* for each.
description: Simulates the pressure‑sensitive reaction rate system with a large initial entropy kernel for the two specified φ values. Blowup times are recorded.

title: Write reproduction results CSV
action: Aggregate all recorded values into a CSV file with columns: phi, inert_max, chem_acoustic_tstar, full_tstar, blowup_mode, pressure_tstar_phi125, pressure_tstar_phi5.
description: CSV file containing all reproduced numerical results for the ideal gas model with γ=3: maximum sound amplitude for inert resonance, blowup times for chemical‑acoustic linear resonance, full temperature‑dependent system, and pressure‑sensitive system. Rows correspond to φ values 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, 0.75, 0.875. For the pressure‑sensitive columns, only rows φ=0.125 and φ=0.5 contain values; all other rows are left empty.
output_schema: phi (float), inert_max (float), chem_acoustic_tstar (float), full_tstar (float), blowup_mode (string), pressure_tstar_phi125 (float or empty), pressure_tstar_phi5 (float or empty)
